x_linked_recessive.note: carrier mother; unaffected embryos selectable (may also select sex)

chromosomal.note: euploid fraction (aneuploidy risk / translocation-carrier segregation), age-dependent

multifactorial.note: no single-locus target; selection is polygenic (see viability model)

aggregate.note: Illustrative upper-bound contrast: if every PGT-addressable affected birth in the catalogue were averted by embryo SELECTION, roughly this many affected embryos would not be selected for transfer per year (each unaffected child implies (1−u)/u affected embryos set aside). Under an idealized EDITING strategy that figure is ~0 (the corrected embryo remains a transfer candidate). Real programs use a mix and coverage is far below 100%, so treat this as a scale contrast, not a forecast. PND (prenatal diagnosis) is a separate moral category — termination of an affected fetus, not embryo non-selection — and is tracked separately in the prevention model.

note: Embryo cost is an explicit outcome tracked across the analysis. Selection sets aside (1−u)/u affected embryos per unaffected child (not selected for transfer) and diverges as u→0 — the case where no unaffected embryo exists; idealized correction sets aside none, though editing failure, mosaicism, and safety-related loss are not modeled. This is the basis on which editing can be preferable to selection for conditions with few unaffected embryos.
